info.name: 6D Mail Pro
info.summary: Experimental foundation for a clearer mail workspace
info.description: Experimental independent mail workspace with synthetic previews and an opt-in read-only public OCS provider for Mail 5.11.5. Lists accounts, folders and singleton message summaries with Unread/Favorite filters, tag-based Important indicators, pagination and native Mail handoff. Tested with synthetic mail in isolated Nextcloud 33.0.6/PHP 8.3.33. No message actions or body rendering are implemented; production compatibility is not verified.
info.author: IAMPMPKSAMY
